visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair and bangs, wearing a black textured short-sleeved top, sits in a bedroom setting. She speaks directly to the camera with a bright, friendly facial expression. The background includes a white bed and a doorway leading to a brightly lit modern bathroom. (2) She holds up a white square container of skincare toner pads. She opens the lid with her hands, takes out a white pad, and gently wipes it across her cheeks, forehead, and nose. She then places a pad on her cheek to demonstrate how it can be used for localized masking. (3) The woman presents a white tube with pink and black lettering. She applies a small amount of white cream to the back of her hand and spreads it, then applies it to her face using circular massage motions. She tilts her face to show the reflective glow on her skin under the indoor lighting. (4) She holds both products, the square container and the tube, side-by-side near her face. She continues talking enthusiastically, gesturing with her hands towards her skin texture and the product packaging to emphasize the results.
